title: Sequential Games
summary: We formulate a time-series game in which each player chooses a hidden Markov model (HMM) as a mixed strategy. The HMM generates a finite, variable-length sequence of probability vectors, and the payoff is assigned to the completed game as the sum of its stage rewards. We prove a conditional Nash-equilibrium existence result for games with a common finite bound on output lengths.
